name: httpRequest
description: Issue an HTTP request of any method against a public URL via the Chromium net stack — the general form of network.httpGet, for the plugin $.http.fetch noun and the settings `http` hooks. Runs in the browser process (NOT subject to renderer CORS), under the egress policy: the IP the socket connects to, at the first response and at every redirect hop, must be publicly routable — loopback, private (RFC 1918 / 4193), link-local (incl. 169.254.169.254), carrier-grade NAT and multicast are refused with EGRESS_BLOCKED; an IP-literal host in one of those ranges is refused before dialing. Through a proxy the socket's peer is the proxy, so only the literal-host check applies. Response body returned as bytes via the bridge's binary transport. Redirects: by default a 3xx comes back as-is; followRedirects=true follows up to maxRedirects hops, each hop re-checked.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Length-capped at 2000, no embedded credentials.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: HTTP method, upper-cased token (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS). Default GET. CONNECT, TRACE and TRACK are refused.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Optional request headers — a map of string -> string. Hop-by-hop and the forbidden request headers (Host, Content-Length, Connection, Cookie, ...) are dropped. Content-Type defaults to application/octet-stream when a body is present and none is given.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Optional request body (inline array<integer> or a transferred port carrying an ArrayBuffer). Refused on GET and HEAD. Capped at 16 MiB (REQUEST_TOO_LARGE).

inputs.name: followRedirects
inputs.description: Follow 3xx responses up to maxRedirects hops (each hop re-checked against the egress policy). Default false.

inputs.name: maxRedirects
inputs.description: Maximum redirect hops when followRedirects=true. Default 10.

inputs.name: allowPrivateNetwork
inputs.description: Opt out of the egress policy for this request (a local dev server the person named). Default false. The guest exposes this only where a person, not a plugin or the model, asked.
